generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors Registration certificate enrolled under KPWD (Active in the period) Class- III & Above for work
The Income tax returns filed duly mentioning PAN No., for the F.Y year 2024-25 (assessment year 2025-26)
Employees provident fund (EPF) registration certificate
A copy of the GST Certificate /Provisional GST Certificate
SC Category contractors for work should upload a scan copy of Caste Certificate issued from competent authority
SC Category Contractor should upload a scan copy Domicile certificate issued by competent authority of Karnataka and should submit the hard copy of original Domicile certificate for verification

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least any construction work to an extent 25% of the amount put to tender i.e Rs. 12.22Lakhs during last five years. (i.e.,from 2021-22 to 2025-26) for SC Category contractors The work done certificate should be obtained duly signed from an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division shall be uploaded (Additional Weight age at 10% each year will be given for cost of work to bring it to 2026-27 level

To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period achieved in at least One financial year an average turnover of work Rs.48.91 lakhs Audited balance sheet certified by the chartered accountant should be enclosed. Copies of Income Tax returns filed for the years indicated above should be furnished duly mentioning UDIN Number (Additional weightage 10% for each year will be given for turn over to bring it to 2026-27)

BID CAPACITY: The tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value the available tender Capacity will be calculated as under: For work Assessed available tender Capacity (AxNx5.00-B)

The financial bid documents for the above work comprises of financial bid to indicate the amount of offered by the bidder for completion of the work on percentage basis based on scope of work. Specifications, Schedule-A and Schedule-B of the contract form. The contractor should give detailed execution plan and furnish program to complete the work in all respect within the stipulated period of completion
The contractor should neither make any alteration in the conditions of contract nor stipulate any condition of his own

The Cover-I (Technical Bid) will be opened first and there after Cover-II (Financial Bid) of only those bidders who fulfill the conditions as mentioned will be opened subject to the condition that the EMD payment is confirmed in the e-portal
The bidder shall ensure credit of tender processing fee in to the respective receiving bank accounts of e-procurement on or before the last date of bid submission

The tenderer is requested to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The department is not being responsible for non-accessibility of e-procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submission of the tenders
The Contractor bidding for more than one work and his tender accepted for more than one work, will be awarded priority based on emergency work to be taken up as per site condition

If the percentage quoted by contractor for the work is below the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) then the successful contractor shall furnish an additional performance security in the form of Bank Guarantee for minimum period of 1 year, for an amount equivalent to the difference between the cost as per quoted percentage and the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) before executing the agreement. In case of contractor quoting the percentage above One Hundred and ten percent (110%) of the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) then the amount over and above One Hundred and Ten percent (110%) of the amount put to tender (updated cost as per CSR) will be withheld during the progress of work

he necessary certificates / documents in support of eligibility criteria fulfilled as stipulated shall be scanned and attached to e-tender document. The Original certificates/documents shall be produced on or before stipulated date and time for verification. Scanned signature of the bidder/authorized representative of the bidder shall be attached while up loading bid document
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever
The contractor will have to make their own arrangements for all the machinery necessary for the works
Corrigendum will be published in web site for all modifications/corrections if any

The intending bidders should note that, if any of lands either in part/parts or whole required for the work is not acquired by the Nigam, it shall be the responsibility of the bidder to take possession of such land and start the work by the consent of the land owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Nigam and no claim whatsoever relating to non availability of land would be entertained
The contractor should mention their recent correct postal address, e-mail address and Contact Number in the declaration form
Incomplete tender documents will be rejected

All the materials like steel, cement etc., required for the above work should be procured by the contractor only at his own cost. And these materials will have to be got tested by the competent authority before put to use
The Contractor shall send authorization letter for their representative duly attesting their signature
As per the Karnataka building and other construction workers welfare cess act 1996, 1.00% of the bill amount will be deducted from the bills
Tenders will be opened on the due date in presence of the contractor or their Authorized representatives
The contractors should adhere to the accepted action plan submitted by him under any circumstances without linking to the pending bill payment of the work
Typo-graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the Contractor
Tendering by the joint venture will not be allowed
The contractor should furnish the name of the individual /firm with address and Telephone numbers with place of registration, year of incorporation etc
The tender processing charges paid by the bidders are not refundable even if the tenders are cancelled
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders

Regarding deduction of Royalty charges for procurement of all materials required for the work- the guidelines issued by the Director of Mines & Geological Department vide circular No 2023-24/8708 Dt:26.12.2023 are to be strictly followed.

The tenderer has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorized quality control authority, before execution.
Sub leasing of work in any form is prohibited

No quarries are approved by KNNL for materials. The quarries considered are for the estimate purpose only. The intending bidders shall visit the site, identify the quarries, as certain availability for the quantity and quality of the materials required for the work and shall quote his rates accordingly. No extra claim whatsoever will be entertained in this regard

On account of restrictions on sand mining and scarcity of availability of sand, as an alternative the use of Manufacture Sand (M sand) may be allowed during the remodelling work at no cost/implication with written approval from the competent authority

The rates include all lead and lifts and work shall be carried out as per instruction of Engineer in charge. All specification are as per relevant IS codes in vogue and Indian Road Congress. The rates for the specification in the schedule B includes all lead and lifts irrespective of the distance and height, no extra claim will be entertained for additional lead and lifts

If Nigam wishes to engage third party inspecting agency for the said work, apart from the quality Control authorities and field tests of Nigam, the Contractor should co-operate with the third party and quality control authorities
The Agency should establish field laboratory at his cost with requirement, or as stipulated in the Agreement
The tender inviting authority has got right either accepting tender or rejecting the tender without assigning any reasons
The validity period of EMD shall be for a minimum period of 225 days from the date of opening of the tenders
EMD of unsuccessful bidders will be refunded only after the acceptance of tenders by the competent authority
The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST. The contractor shall quote the rate exclusive of GST
GST shall be paid to the tender amount as per prevailing Government orders

The contractor shall ensure that no mechanical equipment or manual operation damages the canal lining, masonry structures, concrete structures, or embankments during the execution of work. Excavation of silt shall be carried out only to the required level and shall not disturb the original bed profile, canal section, or stability of the banks
The contractor shall follow all instructions issued by the Engineer-in-Charge during the execution of work and ensure proper supervision to avoid any damage to government property

Any negligence leading to damage of canal structures or government property will be the sole responsibility of the contractor, and the cost of repair/reconstruction will be recovered from the contractor
Further information can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, KNNL, No.5 Canal Division, Yermarus Camp during office hours.

SC Category contractors Security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price shall be deducted in every running bill .However incase of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repair of pipe outlets ,Removal of silt and jungle from km 0.00 to 15.00 and improvement of service road from km 14.00 to 15.00 of distributary 98 0f TLBC (in selected reaches)

itemList.description:
Clearing and grubbing road land including uprooting rank vegetation, grass, bushes, shrubs, saplings and trees girth up to 300 mm, removal of stumps of trees cut earlier and disposal of unserviceable materials and stacking of serviceable material to be used or auctioned, including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness.(ii)By Mechanical Means using Dozer In area of light jungle.(PWD SR, Vol- 3, P.NO 9, item no 2.4. For the year 2023-24).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

De-silting of Feeder Channel/Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and disposing off the same by stacking/ formation of Embankment or as directed including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works as directed and complete as per specification.(WRD SR ,VOL-4 , Pg No: 140, item no 3.13 for the year 2023-24).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead(II) By Mechanical means(a)Cement concrete grade M-15 & M-20.(SR PWD Vol-3, S l No 2.8 , P.No.10, For the year2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Dismantling of existing structures like culverts, bridges, retaining walls and other structure comprising of masonry, cement concrete, wood work, steel work, including T&P and scaffolding wherever necessary, sorting the dismantled material, disposal of unserviceable material and stacking the serviceable material with all lifts and lead(II) By Mechanical means( A) Dismantling Brick / Tile work / rubble masonry / pitching / etc by mechanical means.(SR PWD Vol-3, S l No 2.11 , P.No.10, For the year2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3m , as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools,usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work.(In all kinds of soils depth upto 3m)(Common SR, Vol 1, P.NO 8, I.NO 1.14 For the year 2023-24).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing and laying in position cement concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushedgraded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machineries, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.(Mix 1:3:6 (M10) Using 40 mm and down size graded crushed coarse aggregates)(Common SR Item.No.Vol-1, 2.1.3 , P.No.15, For the year 2023-24).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing and laying in position cement concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necesary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. (MIX 1:2:4(M15)Using 20 mm and down size graded crushed coarse aggregates).(Common SR Item.No.Vol-1, 2.4.1 , P.No.16, for the year 2023-24 ).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening,cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification.(COMMON SR ,VOL-1,Item No : 2.11(f) , Pg No :18 , For the year 2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing casing embankment for breached /damaged portion of canal using approved pervious/semi-pervious soil in layers of 100 to 150 mm(before compaction) including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, all operations such as collection of soil ,spreading soil in layer of specified thickness, sorting out, breaking clods, sectioning sides/ edges, watering, compacting each layer to density control on not less than 95 percent or as stipulated using power roller or pneumatic/vibrating plate compactors with all other ancillary operations complete(from borrow areas)(WRD SR ,VOL-4,Item No :8.18 .1, Pg104, For the year 2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Fabrication, supply, erection, testing and commissioning of sliding type vertical lift gate consisting of skin plate, horizontal and vertical stiffeners, seal seats, sponge rubber seals lifting handles and all necessary works with all accessories for vented dam/field channel including cost of all materials, labour, cutting ,aligning ,welding, finishing, cleaning, applying two coats of anti-corrosive bituminous black paint over a coat of zinc chromate red oxide specifications and primer paint, seal fixing & all necessary works complete as per approved drawings and as directed and complete as per specification.(WRD SR ,VOL-4,Item No :2.2 , Pg No 133, For the year 2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing and laying Reinforced cement concrete pipe light duty NP2 for culverts, road way utilities & crossings as per IS 458:2003 in single row including pointing ends and fixing collars with cement mortar 1:2 including cost of all materials, labour,curing complete as per specification.(Reference to Item No.8.58,(a) Vide Page No.80 Vol III of Common SR of 2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing and laying Reinforced cement concrete pipe light duty NP2 for culverts, road way utilities & crossings as per IS 458:2003 in single row including pointing ends and fixing collars with cement mortar 1:2 including cost of all materials, labour,curing complete as per specification.(Reference to Item No.8.58,(b) Vide Page No.80 Vol III of Common SR of 2023-2024).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing and laying insitu vibrated M-15 grade cement concrete using 40mm down approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates for bed lining of canal including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, batching, mixing, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing, curing with all other ancillary operations complete.(Common SR Item.No.Vol-4, 3.27 , P.No.51, for the year 2023-24).
 ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge

Providing and laying insitu vibrated M-15 grade cement concrete using 20 mm down approved, clean, hard, graded aggregates for side lining of canal including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, batching, mixing, supports, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing junction of bed and sides to required curvature ,finishing side slopes, curing with all other ancillary operations complete .(Common SR, Vol-4 ,item No -3.26.1, P.NO 51 , For the year 2023-24). ---- As per direction of Engineer in charge
